video.title: Cloud Engineer Roadmap 2022 | How to become Cloud Engineer ☁️  #cloudcomputing #devops

transcript.text: cloud engineer or cloud architect is one
of the highest paying jobs if you want
to become a cloud engineer these are the
five skills you need to have
number one is linux linux is the
operating system of the cloud it is very
important for every cloud engineer to
have a good hands-on knowledge on linux
number two programming language a cloud
engineer needs to write programs to
automate tasks and to create
applications you can go with any
programming language but if you don't
have any preference i would suggest you
to go with either python or go language
number three is going to be networking a
cloud engineer needs to know how
internet works how to set up vpns load
balancers gateways not gateways
number four is going to be knowledge of
any cloud provider it can be aws gcp or
microsoft azure but a cloud engineer
should know how to deploy architectures
and applications on the cloud number
five is databases a cloud engineer
should know how to work with different
databases like postgres mysql mongodb
documentdb
